candidate_relations.reason: CT confirmed acute interstitial pancreatitis, but the benchmark diagnosis requires the EUS-demonstrated ductal anomaly and fistulous pancreatic duct leakage toward the diaphragm with amylase/lipase-positive pleural fluid.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Acute pancreatitis is a manifestation but does not identify complete pancreatic divisum or the pancreatic-pleural fistula.
